messages:
violet: Noticing a subtle jump-to-anchor problem on the 'getting-started' page after the latest mkdocs update. The image caption headings (like 'Usage (PNG)') are generating slugs with parentheses encoded differently in staging vs prod.

omar: Can you paste the rendered anchors?

violet: On staging the img caption becomes `usage-png` but prod (served via our older build) shows `usage-(png)` which means internal links to `/docs/getting-started#usage-(png)` 404 on staging.

link-bot: linkcheck: Broken fragment /docs/getting-started#usage-(png) -> 404

zach: That smells like different slugify versions: one strips parens, the other preserves them. We've got two slug rules in the pipeline (mkdocs-plugin-slugify and our docusaurus slugger shim).

rachel: Quick fix options: 1) normalize to a single canonical sluger across both builds, or 2) emit alias IDs on headings so both variants resolve. I prefer canonicalize + redirects.

omar: Agreed. Also we should avoid using punctuation-heavy headings for image captions (authors often include file extensions). We can add a docs lint rule to warn about parentheses in headings.

violet: I grepped the repo: `git grep -n "#.*(png|jpg|svg)" docs | sed -E 's/:.*$//' | sort -u` -> found 12 pages with image-ext in headings.

zach: I'll add a small remark plugin to normalize heading text before slug generation (strip parens and extensions). We'll also create a `_redirects` map for the old variants.

link-bot: CI queued for PR 4723 (slug normalization for image captions + redirects).

omar: One gotcha: some external blogs link to the old slug with parens. Redirects will help but let's also add a small middleware on the site that tolerates decoded/encoded parentheses in fragment lookup.

rachel: Good idea. For testing I'll add a unit test matrix: `slugify('Usage (PNG)') -> usage-png` and `anchorAlias('usage-(png)')` maps to `usage-png`.

violet: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4723 (includes remark plugin, redirects file, lint rule, and tests).

link-bot: build started for PR 4723 (mkdocs build + linkcheck).

zach: Running local linkcheck on the branch: initial run found 12 broken fragments, after patch down to 1 (an external wiki link).

link-bot: CI update: build passed, linkcheck OK :white_check_mark:. Staging shows redirects resolving.

omar: Merged. Left a small migration note in docs/migration.md and pinged support to watch for anchor-related tickets.

rachel: Also added a short authoring tip in CONTRIBUTING.md: "Avoid file extensions in headings; prefer 'Usage' not 'Usage (PNG)'."

violet: Thanks all. Closing this thread unless someone sees a regression.

zach: nice catch, @violet :clap:
